commit.subject: LU-18687 build: remove FALLOC_FL_* flags from lustre_compat.h
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: remove FALLOC_FL_* flags from lustre_compat.h

These flags have been around long enough that they can be safely
dropped:

Linux commit v3.14-rc1-1-g00f5e61998dd1
  fs: Add new flag(FALLOC_FL_COLLAPSE_RANGE) for fallocate

Linux commit v3.14-rc1-3-g409332b65d3ed
  fs: Introduce FALLOC_FL_ZERO_RANGE flag for fallocate

v4.0-rc1-9-gdd46c787788d5
  fs: Add support FALLOC_FL_INSERT_RANGE for fallocate

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Shaun Tancheff <shaun@tancheff.com>
